outcome: Survival rate at 1 year of life
Survival rate beyond 24 hours of life
cohort: All resuscitated live births delivered between 22 0/7 and 23 6/7 weeks of gestational age in the United States between 2007 and 2013
finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with increased survival at 1 year of life among resuscitated, periviable infants born between 22 0/7 and 23 6/7 weeks of gestation, especially in the setting of nonvertex presentation.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with increased survival at 1 year of life among resuscitated, periviable infants born between 22 0/7 and 23 6/7 weeks of gestation, especially in the setting of nonvertex presentation.
